name: typefix-20261111-stage-mysql-dev
description: Typefix 20261111, step 1 of 2: stages the legacy MySQL values of the deal columns that numeric(18,4) cut (original_lots, premium, spcl_rate, active_lots, netted_lots from cloned_deal_ticket_table_<bu>; lots_to_be_netted from the latest deal_ticket_table_<bu> version, as the migration loader load_09_logical.ps1 takes them) into opera.typefix_20261111_src, one step per business unit. Only trades with a value that has more than 4 decimals are read. Insert only; each BU scope must be empty before. The staging table is created first in DBeaver (see typefix-20261111-reload-dev.json). Step 2: typefix-20261111-reload-dev.json.

source.sql: SELECT s.trade_id, s.original_lots, s.premium, s.spcl_rate, s.active_lots, s.netted_lots, d.lots_to_be_netted FROM dbsystemuat.cloned_deal_ticket_table_bkr s LEFT JOIN (SELECT x.trade_id, x.lots_to_be_netted, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY x.trade_id ORDER BY x.version_no DESC) AS rn FROM dbsystemuat.deal_ticket_table_bkr x) d ON d.trade_id = s.trade_id AND d.rn = 1 WHERE s.premium <> ROUND(s.premium, 4) OR s.original_lots <> ROUND(s.original_lots, 4) OR s.spcl_rate <> ROUND(s.spcl_rate, 4) OR s.active_lots <> ROUND(s.active_lots, 4) OR s.netted_lots <> ROUND(s.netted_lots, 4) OR d.lots_to_be_netted <> ROUND(d.lots_to_be_netted, 4)
